distribution: Beibeng and Ani Bridge, Motuo, Tibet.
soldier: Head yellowish brown, nasus black, pronotum yellowish brown, abdominal tergites paler. Head almost bare, or covered with minute down, the tip of the nasus sparsely covered with fine hairs, the anterior margin of the pronotum with small hairs, the abdominal tergites and sternites with sparse fine hairs. Head pear-shaped, wider than long, widest at the middle, the posterior margin rather flat and slightly concave in the middle, the anterior part straight in lateral view. The tip of the nasus slender and not turned up, the base of the nasus slightly raised, the fontanelle tube distinct, extending to the anterior middle of the head. Labrum lamellate, wider than long, the middle of the anterior margin bowing forwards. Mandibles block-like, usually without an apical spine, or with a triangular apical spine on one side, the anterior margin slightly curved, the inner surface more deeply sclerotised and small. Antennae with 12 to 13 segments, mostly 13, segment 4 shortest and almost rectangular; sometimes 12 segments on one side and 13 on the other, segment 4 occasionally divided in two; segment 3 longer than segment 2, and in the 12-segmented form segment 4 longer than segment 2. Pronotum saddle-shaped.
